invite.name: Full name
invite.claimedHint: The level the student says they hold. The exam checks it.

invite.errGENERIC: The invitation could not be created.

invite.forWhomPlacement: For new students: decides which class they join.
invite.forWhomQuick: For a quick first impression: grammar only, a rough level.
invite.forWhomLevelCheck: For a student who states their level: checks it in four skills.

examWizard.startTitle: How do you want to start?
examWizard.startLead: Starting from a ready exam is easiest. You can change the sections, times and proctoring in the next steps.
examWizard.blankBody: You pick the exam type and set the sections and times yourself.
examWizard.sectionsLead: Switch off any section you do not want and set the times in minutes.
examWizard.aboutREADING: Short texts with questions on them.
examWizard.aboutLISTENING: Recordings to listen to, with questions.
examWizard.aboutWRITING: The student writes a short text.
examWizard.aboutSPEAKING: The student answers out loud; the answer is recorded.
examWizard.kindAdaptive: Questions get easier or harder with the student's answers.
examWizard.kindFixed: Everyone gets a set number of questions per level.
examWizard.kindTasks: {n, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}; a teacher grades the answer.
examWizard.needSection: At least one section must be on.
examWizard.proctoringTitle: How closely should the exam be watched?
examWizard.proctoringLead: Before starting, the student goes through the checks the level asks for. No flag ever ends an exam by itself.
examWizard.presetOFFBody: Camera, microphone and screen are not watched. For short, low-stakes screens.
examWizard.presetSTANDARDBody: Camera and microphone on, the exam in full screen, copy and paste off. No screen sharing.
examWizard.presetSTRICTBody: Standard plus screen sharing, no start with a second screen, Chrome or Edge only.
examWizard.computerBody: Students take the exam on a computer; it does not open on phones or tablets. Tell them when you share the link.
examWizard.computerShort: The exam does not open on phones or tablets.
examWizard.reviewLead: This is the exam the student will take. Once it is published you can invite students.
examWizard.nameHint: Students see this name. Left empty, the grey name is used.
examWizard.checksNone: Camera, microphone and screen are not watched.
examWizard.coverageOk: The question bank has enough questions for this exam.
examWizard.coverageMissing: The bank is missing questions: {list}. To publish, fill the bank or switch that section off.
examWizard.detailsHint: Finer settings such as question counts, showing the result to the student and single proctoring switches are on the exam's edit page. Save a draft to go there.
examWizard.draft: Save a draft and edit in detail
examWizard.errTEMPLATE: This template was not found. Pick another start.
examWizard.errNO_SECTION: At least one section must be on.
examWizard.errINVALID: The exam could not be saved with these settings. Check the times.
examWizard.errCOVERAGE: The bank does not have enough questions for this exam; it was not published.
examWizard.errFAILED: The exam could not be saved. Try again.
examWizard.doneLead: You can invite students now. Every student you invite gets the exam as it is now.
examWizard.shiftApplies: Affects the fixed-form sections only ({list}): moves all their questions one CEFR level down or up.
examWizard.shiftAdaptiveToo: {list} adaptive: questions are chosen by the student's answers, so this setting does not affect them.
examWizard.shiftOff: This exam's question sections are adaptive: questions are chosen by the student's answers, so the level is not shifted. Switch "Adaptive" off in a section to use this setting.
examWizard.shiftNotItem: Not the same as a question's own Easy / Medium / Hard label: that label is the difficulty within one level.
examWizard.inviteListLabel: One student per line: Full name, e-mail
examWizard.inviteListPlaceholder:
Ayşe Yılmaz, ayse@example.com
Can Demir, can@example.com
examWizard.inviteListHint: You can copy the name and e-mail columns from Excel or Google Sheets and paste them. One line is enough for one student. At most {max} students.
examWizard.inviteCsvHint: The file's lines land in the box above, where you can fix them.
examWizard.inviteCsvSize: This file is too large for a class list (256 KB at most).
examWizard.inviteCsvRead: The file could not be read. Save it as CSV and try again, or copy and paste the lines.
examWizard.inviteRowNAME: Line {line}: the name is missing or too short.
examWizard.inviteRowEMAIL: Line {line}: the e-mail is not valid.
examWizard.inviteRowDUPLICATE: Line {line}: this e-mail is already on the list.
examWizard.inviteReady: {count, plural, one {# student ready} other {# students ready}}
examWizard.inviteWaitEMPTY: Write at least one student first.
examWizard.inviteWaitPROBLEMS: Fix or delete the marked lines.
examWizard.inviteWaitTOO_MANY: You can invite at most {max} students at once. Split the list.
examWizard.inviteWaitCOVERAGE: The bank does not have enough questions for this exam.
examWizard.inviteErrLIST: The list has lines to fix.
examWizard.inviteExamLead: Everyone on the list is invited to the same exam. For new students, pick the Placement test.
examWizard.inviteClaimHint: For everyone whose line names no level. A level written on a line (Ayşe Yılmaz, ayse@example.com, B1) wins.
examWizard.inviteReviewLead: Each student gets a link of their own.
examWizard.inviteNoMail: Links are not e-mailed. On the next screen you copy each student's link and send it yourself. Tell the students to take the exam on a computer.
examWizard.inviteRepeated: {count, plural, one {This student already has an open invitation} other {These # students already have an open invitation}}: {list}. A new invitation opens a second exam.
examWizard.inviteCreate: {count, plural, one {Create the invitation} other {Create # invitations}}
examWizard.inviteLanguageTitle: Which language should the student see?
examWizard.inviteLanguageLead: The questions stay in German; this is the language of the instructions and buttons.
examWizard.inviteDoneTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No invitation was created} one {The invitation is ready} other {# invitations are ready}}
examWizard.inviteComputer: Tell the students to take the exam on a computer; it does not open on phones or tablets.
examWizard.inviteFailedTitle: {count, plural, one {One student could not be invited} other {# students could not be invited}}
examWizard.linkUSED: The exam is finished; the link opens nothing any more.
examWizard.linkEXPIRED: The link has expired. Create a new invitation.
examWizard.linkNOT_RECOVERABLE: This invitation was created before links were kept; its link cannot be shown again. Create a new invitation if needed.
examWizard.linkFAILED: The link could not be fetched. Try again.

bankTools.withinHintHARD: The hard end of the level

bankTools.noSelection: Select at least one question first.

bankTools.bulkNoAudio: {n} listening questions have no audio; make it on the question's page.
bankTools.bulkSkipped: {n} questions were already approved or not found.

bankTools.invalidLead: This question cannot be approved yet:
bankTools.errorInvalid: Not approved: the question is incomplete.
bankTools.errorAudio: Not approved: the listening audio is missing.
bankTools.savedApproved: Saved. The question stays approved; later exams use the new version.
bankTools.typeLead: Pick the section first, then the question type.
bankTools.hintTRUE_FALSE_NG: Richtig, falsch or nicht im Text
bankTools.hintGAP_FILL: Gaps the student types or picks from a list
bankTools.contentLead: Write what the student sees and the correct answer.
bankTools.locked: Section and question type stay as they are; add a new question for another type.
bankTools.gapHint: Type ___ where a gap goes, or place the cursor and press Add a gap.
bankTools.gapChoices: Choices (separate with |, include the correct one)
bankTools.extraTargetHint: One target more than rows makes guessing harder.
bankTools.explanation: Explanation (the student does not see it)
bankTools.listeningText: Listening script (the student does not see it; the audio is made from it)

bankTools.approvedWarning: This question is approved and used in exams. Saving keeps it approved, and later exams use the new version. The version students already answered stays as it was in their results.
bankTools.approvedNoRight: Only someone who may approve can edit an approved question.
bankTools.draftNote: The new question is added as a draft; it reaches no exam before approval.
bankTools.fileLead: Are your questions in a spreadsheet? Choose the CSV file, or copy the cells and paste them.
bankTools.fileTypes: CSV or TSV, up to 700 KB
bankTools.pastePlaceholder: Paste the cells here, header row included
bankTools.templateHint: It has one example row per question type. Open it in Excel or Google Sheets, fill in your questions and save it as CSV.
bankTools.colType: type: single choice, multiple choice, true/false, gap fill, matching or short text.
bankTools.colSettings: section, level, difficulty: optional; when empty, what you choose for the whole file in step 3 is used.
bankTools.colText: text_title, text: an optional reading text or listening script. Rows with the same title share one text; write the text once.
bankTools.colQuestion: question: the stem. In gap fill, type ___ for each gap.
bankTools.colOptions: a-h: the options; in true/false the statements; in gap fill the choices of gap 1, 2, ... (das | den | dem); in matching "row = target", and "= target" for an extra target.
bankTools.colAnswer: answer: the option letter (b) or letters (a, c); in true/false R, F or NG per statement; in gap fill each gap's answer, separated by ; with other spellings after |.
bankTools.needFile: Choose or paste a file first.
bankTools.sheetNO_HEADER: The first row has no column names. Use the header row of the example file.
bankTools.sheetUNTERMINATED: A cell opens a quote and never closes it.
bankTools.sheetTOO_MANY_ROWS: One file may hold at most {max} questions; split the file.
bankTools.fileTooBig: The file is too large; at most 700 KB. Split the file.
bankTools.fileUnreadable: The file could not be read.
bankTools.fileExcel: Save the Excel file as CSV first (File, Save as, CSV).
bankTools.checkLead: {ok} questions are ready, {bad} rows have a problem.
bankTools.fixLead: Fix the cell here; the change applies to this upload only.
bankTools.skipNote: Rows with a problem are left out; fix them and they are added.
bankTools.noValid: Nothing to add: fix at least one row first.
bankTools.settingsLead: Choose for the whole file. You can change single rows below.
bankTools.ownValues: {n} rows have their own value in the file; they keep it.
bankTools.alreadyAdded: The questions of this file were added.
bankTools.doneLead: The new questions wait for approval as drafts; none reaches an exam before approval.
bankTools.openPending: Open the questions waiting for approval

bankTools.p_GAP_KEY_UNKNOWN: The answer key names a gap that does not exist ({ids}).

bankTools.p_MATCH_KEY_UNKNOWN_ROW: The answer key names a row that does not exist ({ids}).
bankTools.p_SHORT_NO_ANSWER: At least one accepted answer is needed.

examRecording.title: Exam recording
examRecording.gapCamera: No camera recording for this moment
examRecording.gapScreen: No screen recording for this moment

examRecording.legend: The ticks at the top are proctoring flags; click one to go to that moment. The two strips at the bottom show where there is a recording: the upper one the camera, the lower one the screen.
examRecording.legendOne: The ticks at the top are proctoring flags; click one to go to that moment. The strip at the bottom shows where there is a recording.
